title: Three Days and One Short Ticket
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：plane　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 plane 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the driver ① boarded the plane that no passenger in the station would have counted, and he said the boarding was the whole of the day. The ② plane, meaning the aircraft itself and not the ticket, ran three days and stayed uncounted in the book; a plane, he said, is the only thing in a station that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ plane in that station had the same short ticket beside it, and the ④ plane at the far platform, meaning the seat they kept for the children to book and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A plane, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the driver said the counting is the part that fills three days.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the plane was the whole of the matter, meaning the distance and not the aircraft. The ⑥ plane, meaning the distance and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; plane, he said, is either something you board or the only word that means both an aircraft and a distance. He said the distance is the part they remember.

By 1977 the ⑦ plane had become a line in a timetable, and the timetable had become an argument about the short ticket. The ⑧ plane of the whole thing, the driver wrote in February, was one station and three days of counting; plane, he said, is either the seat at the far platform or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ plane I remember is the aircraft counted in the timetable, which closed in 1979 and is still counted as the quietest in the station. A ⑩ plane, my mother said in 1981, is the only aircraft that improves by being counted; every plane, she said, is a distance that has agreed to look like an aircraft. She said the distance was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 飞机（指车站里每一架旁边的那一架）
B. n. 飞机（指那架飞机本身，与薄薄的车票相对）
C. 固定搭配：board the plane 登这一架飞机
D. n. 飞机（指留给孩子们订的那一个）
E. n. 飞机之事（抽象总称，指一处车站的飞机之事）
F. n. 飞机（指时刻表里写到、被清点的那一架）
G. n. 飞机、远行（指一件事里人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 远行（抽象总称，指人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: boarded the plane that no passenger in the station would have counted
The plane, meaning the aircraft itself and not the ticket
the plane at the far platform
the plane was the whole of the matter
the plane had become a line in a timetable
The plane of the whole thing
A plane, my mother said in 1981

answers.why: board the plane 意为“登这一架飞机”，1972 年那位司机把车站里没有一位乘客肯清点的一架飞机做了一遍。
plane 意为“飞机”，指那架飞机本身而不是薄薄的车票，它经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被清点。
plane 意为“飞机”，指车站里每一架旁边的那一架，每一架旁边都有同一张薄薄的车票。
plane 意为“飞机”，指最远那座站台的留给孩子们订的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
plane 意为“飞机、远行”，指一件事里人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这架远行就是那件事的全部。
plane 意为“远行”，指人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西而不是那架飞机，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
plane 意为“飞机”，指时刻表里写到、被清点的那一架，到 1977 年这一架成了时刻表里的一行。
plane 意为“飞机之事”，司机二月写道，整件事的飞机之事是一处车站和三个日子的清点。
plane 意为“飞机”，我记得的是时刻表里清点过的那一架，1979 年到站了，至今仍被说成车站里最安静的一架。
plane 为抽象总称，母亲 1981 年说，飞机是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的飞机。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用

items: 1972 年那位司机登了车站里没有一位乘客肯清点的一架飞机，他说这一遍才是那个日子的全部。（board the plane）
那架飞机，指的是那架飞机本身而不是薄薄的车票，经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被清点。（plane）
那处车站里每一架飞机旁边都有同一张薄薄的车票。（plane）
最远那座站台那架飞机，指的是他们留给孩子们订的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（plane）
叔叔说这架远行就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那架飞机。（plane）
